title: ESTIMATE FWHM SMOOTHNESS OF A VOLUME
description: Estimates the smoothness of the input volume in X, Y, and Z directions separately, printing the estimates to standard output, in mm as FWHM.  If -subvolume or -whole-file are not specified, each subvolume is estimated and displayed separately.

roi.description: use only data within an ROI

subvolume.description: select a single subvolume to estimate smoothness of

demean.description: subtract the mean image before estimating smoothness

whole_file.description: estimate for the whole file at once, not each subvolume separately
